_comment: OpenDART status codes -> {status, message} response shape. 013, 100, 010 are captured live (2026-07-13: list.json with a future date range, fnlttSinglAcntAll.json with a malformed corp_code, corpCode.xml with an invalid key respectively). Note the shape differs by endpoint family: JSON endpoints (list.json/fnlttSinglAcntAll.json) return {status,message} as JSON; file-download endpoints (corpCode.xml/document.xml) return the same fields but as XML `<result><status/><message/></result>` instead of a zip body. The remaining codes use the exact status codes and message text documented at https://opendart.fss.or.kr/guide/main.do?apiGrpCd=DS001 (개발가이드 > 에러코드), not independently re-verified live.
000_success_shape_note: 정상: status=000, list[]가 채워진다(JSON) 또는 zip 바이너리(파일 다운로드). 별도 fixture(disclosure_list_samsung.json 등) 참고.
